name: Necromancy 101
summary: A library collector asks you to add magical works to the collection. Your contributions help expand its knowledge.

sections.title: More for the Library
sections.body: If you find other magical works that could aid the library, its collector welcomes them. The collection grows through your efforts.

faq.answer: The library seeks magical works that could benefit its collection.
Your contributions expand the library's knowledge.

faq.q: Can I bring more works later?
faq.answer: Yes. The collector welcomes other magical works that might benefit the library.
